page: Amazon Web Services u7in-16tb.224xlarge is an ultra-dense, memory-optimized instance built on the AWS Nitro System. At its core, the machine utilizes dedicated Intel x86_64 processors running at a base clock speed of 1.9 GHz. The compute subsystem provides 448 physical cores and 896 virtual CPUs via simultaneous multithreading with two threads per core. The defining attribute of the system is its massive 16,384 GB (16 TB) system memory array, providing a memory allocation of 18.29 GB per virtual core. The platform operates without integrated graphical processing units, focusing compute resources entirely on heavy central processing and in-memory caching.

I/O capabilities and storage architecture are optimized for network-centric data transport. The instance features a baseline network bandwidth of 200 Gbps, accommodating high-throughput data replication, node communication, and storage streaming. It does not include bundled local storage, meaning that all persistent disk storage must be provisioned externally over the network via EBS. In addition, the instance provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The absence of local solid-state drives necessitates planning for network latency profiles when handling secondary storage operations, although the 200 Gbps interconnect provides substantial headroom for storage traffic.

Cost efficiency for this instance is rooted in vertical consolidation rather than horizontal scaling. Operating a single-node memory pool of 16 TB eliminates the communication latency, cluster management complexity, and distributed synchronization overhead found across multi-node database clusters. However, maximizing hardware value demands continuous, near-capacity utilization of the vast memory and thread count. The u7in-16tb.224xlarge is purpose-built for extreme scale-up enterprise workloads, including large-scale in-memory databases such as SAP HANA, massive transactional database management systems, real-time enterprise resource planning deployments, and memory-bound analytics pipelines.
description: Amazon Web Services u7in-16tb.224xlarge is a high-density, memory-optimized instance engineered for extreme in-memory enterprise workloads. Built on the AWS Nitro hypervisor architecture, the platform features 896 dedicated vCPUs spanning 448 physical Intel x86_64 processor cores clocked at 1.9 GHz with two threads per core. The server is distinguished by its 16,384 GB memory pool, delivering approximately 18.29 GB of RAM per vCPU. It lacks bundled local storage and complimentary public IPv4 addresses, necessitating external EBS network volumes for persistent file access. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline throughput of 200 Gbps, enabling rapid data movement across clustered environments. Given the enormous concentration of compute and system memory within a single node, this instance eliminates multi-node distributed overhead for massive datasets, though cost efficiency requires sustained, high-utilization operating models. The u7in-16tb.224xlarge is designed for mission-critical in-memory databases like SAP HANA, large enterprise resource planning platforms, and intensive real-time transactional analytics.
